According to the [[Gungan religion|religion]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], '''Kobble''' was the [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] of feasts and good [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. Along with the trickster god [[Nododo]] and the god of games [[Wamka Pol]], Kobble was one of the less serious [[Gud/Legends|guds]] in the pantheon. The [[Gender/Legends|goddess]] answered to the principal deity [[Oma-Oma]], and all of the guds lived in the beautiful [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Ossorus]].<ref name="SWGB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kobble was mentioned in the [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] edition of the Gungan Databank in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="SWGB" />
